edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 3

source_text: Liber hic non tam gesta filii Nave indicet quam Iesu mei Domini sacramenta depingat. Ipse post mortem Moysi suscepit imperium, ducit exercitum et confligit adversus Amalec; quod in monte manibus extensis adumbrabatur, affigit cruci suae triumphans principatus. Defunctus est Moyses — cessavit lex, quoniam lex et prophetae usque ad Iohannem. Habent Moysen et prophetas — Moysen legem nominans. Mulier vivente viro alligata est legi; si mortuus fuerit vir, soluta est — mulierem animam nominans. Necesse est legem mori, ut qui credunt in Iesu nequaquam adulterii crimen incurrant.
pass_a_gloss: Book this not so-much deeds of-son of-Nun indicates as of-Jesus my Lord sacraments paints. He himself after death of-Moses took command, leads army and fights against Amalek; what on mountain with-hands stretched was-foreshadowed, he-nails to-cross his triumphing over-principalities. Dead is Moses — ceased the-law, because law and prophets until John. They-have Moses and prophets — Moses law naming. Woman with-living husband bound is to-law; if dead shall-have-been husband, freed is — woman soul naming. Necessary is law to-die, so-that who believe in Jesus by-no-means of-adultery crime may-incur.
pass_b_english: Where does all this look? This book does not so much report the deeds of Nun’s son as depict the sacraments of my Lord Jesus. He it is who, after Moses’ death, took the command; he leads the army and [[fights Amalek >> Bible:Exodus 17:9]]; what was foreshadowed on the mountain with outstretched hands he [[nails to his cross, triumphing over principalities and powers >> Bible:Colossians 2:14-15]]. [[Moses died >> Bible:Deuteronomy 34:5]] — for the law ceased, since [[the law and the prophets were until John >> Bible:Matthew 11:13]]. Hear the Gospel: [[They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them >> Bible:Luke 16:29]] — naming Moses as the law. Hear the Apostle: [[a woman is bound to the law while her husband lives; if the husband dies she is free >> Bible:Romans 7:2-3]] — the woman being the soul held under Moses’ law. Therefore the law must die, so that those who believe in Jesus may not incur the charge of adultery.
